notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content: We are happy to announce that Commando Jack now features Steam Trading Cards. The set brings 5 cards, 3 backgrounds, and 5 emoticons. We hope you enjoy them. Thanks for your continued support.
